notes: Scope: SaveOnFoods only. Source: attached Hammer product CSV filtered vendor == SaveOnFoods (16,481 rows) and attached shared/seed/items.ts (128 catalogue items). This is a name/brand/pack-size audit, not a price or availability audit.

Conservative baseline policy: exact nominal pack size required, with customary 1lb=454g, 2lb=907g and 3lb=1.36kg rounding. Do not use the matcher's 15% size tolerance as evidence that different package sizes are equivalent. Exclude explicit organic, premium egg, lactose-free, flavoured, diet/light, prepared-meal and alternative-product variants from unspecified conventional staples. Catalogue items have no fixed brand; ordinary brand alternatives are allowed. Where the catalogue itself is generic, crunchy/smooth peanut butter and ordinary cottage-cheese fat levels are allowed; salt-reduced/light versions are withheld.

Validation: 199 assignments covering 87/128 catalogue items, 1631 exclusions. Every assignment was checked to return a match for its target using the attached unmodified matchProduct and original CSV title/brand/units. No assigned products were absent from the current importer matches; 17 change the current best item.

Current importer baseline: 1,830 matching products across 114 best-item identities. Its parseSize does not understand spelled-out litre, millilitre, kilogram, pound or singular Gram in titles. Vendor units are often spelled out, allowing size checks to be skipped. This override does not repair parsing, identity rules or global selection.

Loose produce is withheld even where the name is good: a nominal mass or 1 Each does not prove the recorded price is per kg or per lb. Fresh produce estimated weights, bag price bases and price normalization need the raw price CSV. Exclusions for this condition prevent silently treating a per-piece price as a per-kg price.

Items without a verified, current-matcher-compatible assignment: bananas-kg, apples-gala-kg, carrots-907g, potatoes-russet-4-54kg, onions-yellow-1-36kg, tomatoes-roma-kg, strawberries-454g, broccoli-kg, milk-lactosefree-2l, milk-oat-1-89l, cheddar-mild-400g, bread-rye-450g, pita-6, dinner-rolls-12, maple-syrup-540ml, rice-brown-2kg, rice-long-2kg, kidney-beans-540ml, chickpeas-540ml, vegetable-oil-3l, soy-sauce-1l, juice-orange-1-75l, juice-apple-1-89l, oranges-navel-kg, pears-kg, grapes-red-kg, pineapple-each, celery-each, cabbage-green-kg, peppers-red-each, peppers-green-each, mushrooms-white-227g, spinach-baby-312g, sweet-potatoes-kg, zucchini-kg, lettuce-iceberg-each, tomatoes-vine-kg, apples-honeycrisp-kg, apples-granny-kg, ginger-kg, onions-red-kg

Good identity/size candidates withheld because the attached strict matcher rejects them: SaveOnFoods00068700011078 -> milk-skim-4l (0% Regular Milk, 4 Litre); SaveOnFoods00068700120008 -> milk-skim-2l (0% Regular Milk, 2 Litre); SaveOnFoods00065784000042 -> milk-1pct-4l (1% Skim Milk, 4 Litre); SaveOnFoods00065784000059 -> milk-1pct-2l (1% Skim Milk, 2 Litre); SaveOnFoods00065784000141 -> milk-2pct-4l (Partly Skimmed Milk 2%, 4 Litre); SaveOnFoods00065784000158 -> milk-2pct-2l (Partly Skimmed Milk 2%, 2 Litre); SaveOnFoods00628011256225 -> milk-2pct-2l (Partly Skimmed Milk 2% M.F., 2 Litre); SaveOnFoods00021130530557 -> potatoes-russet-4-54kg (Russet, 10lb Bag, 1 Each); SaveOnFoods52 -> onions-yellow-1-36kg (Yellow, Mesh Bagged, 3lb, 1 Each); SaveOnFoods05050372115005 -> pineapple-each (Gold, Extra Large, 1 Each)

Additional missing candidates: SaveOnFoods00067800002467 -> kidney-beans-540ml (Unico Red Kidney Beans, 540 Millilitre) and SaveOnFoods00062639198756 -> kidney-beans-540ml (Western Family Dark Red Kidney Beans, 540 Millilitre). Current global red variant conflict rejects them. White kidney beans are not substituted for ordinary red kidney beans.

No credible exact 650g regular variants were inferred from 625g/630g yogurt; 1.89L milk was not treated as 2L, 1.75L oat beverage was not treated as 1.89L, 500mL maple syrup was not treated as 540mL, and 500g rye bread was not treated as 450g. No exact orange 1.75L juice was found beyond an orange/peach/mango blend; apple cider was not substituted for apple juice.

Non-grocery junk: no current-match SaveOnFoods titles were identified as household/personal-care/pet products in targeted review. Many matches were nevertheless non-equivalent groceries (lemon soda, milk desserts, butter bread, strawberry candy, cheese pizza, garlic prepared meats). This is not a claim that the vendor CSV contains no non-grocery rows.

Unverified: raw price history, stock, branch availability, current packaging versus older packages, weight/each price basis, UPC identity and ingredients. Source detail_url fields are empty for reviewed candidates; no external product pages were verified.
